description.value: iCafe Express is a modern Hong Kong-style café inside City Square Shopping Centre on West 12th Avenue, serving a fusion of traditional and contemporary fast food dishes. The kitchen is led by a chef with over 30 years of experience in authentic Hong Kong cuisine, offering both quick counter-service meals and catering for corporate and private events. It is well-positioned for cyclists navigating the Broadway corridor, with multiple ordering options including in-store pickup with no delivery fees.
